name: cancel_started_leave_routed_to_hr_case
use_case: Handle leave request boundaries such as insufficient balance, overlaps, or exceptions via HR case
branch: An employee attempts to cancel an approved leave request that has already passed its start date; direct cancellation is refused and must be routed via an HR case for exception adjustment.
tests: The agent reads REQ-1108 in the HR system, finds it has already started, explains that started leave cannot be cancelled directly, and with the employee's agreement opens an HR case for the adjustment (policy_exception; balance_dispute reaches the same HR partner and also passes).
instruction:
You want to cancel your approved sick leave request (REQ-1108) for October 19 to October 20, 2026. You came back to work sooner than expected and feel those two days should not count against your sick leave.

Ask the HR leave desk to cancel REQ-1108 so the days can be restored to your sick leave balance. If the desk explains that leave which has already started cannot be cancelled directly, agree to it opening an HR policy exception case so HR can adjust the record.

Your details:
- Name: Edward Norton
- Employee ID: E05
- Region: UK
- Leave Request ID: REQ-1108 (sick leave, approved)
- Scheduled Dates: 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-20

persona.name: Edward Norton
persona.initial_message: Hello HR desk, I need to cancel my approved sick leave REQ-1108 from last week (19 to 20 Oct) because I came back to work sooner than expected. Can you please cancel it for me?

arguments.subject: Adjust started sick leave REQ-1108
arguments.description: REQ-1108 (19 to 20 October, sick leave) has already started, so it cannot be cancelled directly; the employee returned to work early and asks HR to adjust the record.

fixed.category: rule: leave already under way is adjusted by the regional HR partner through a case (an exception or a dispute, per the routing table)
